name: The Trainer
description: The Trainer of the game theory videos: the House's man in the room, who runs every game with his own hands. A figure in a grey suit and a plain gold tie, with neat dark hair, heavy-lidded eyes and a small calm smile; the only one in the room with skin and hair, so he is never taken for a player. He is friendly to the player and tells the camera the truth. Look picked by Biku from three on 2026-10-11 (look 3). Trousers and shoes to match his suit, 2026-10-14.
